purpose: Monthly and on-demand audit reports of meta:* label coverage and status:needs-review / status:needs-triage age, uploaded as artefacts.

jobs.summary: Checkout, setup Node, npm ci, create .github/reports/audits, run review-meta-labels.js and review-status-labels.js (markdown on schedule, chosen format on dispatch), upload the reports folder (30 days), echo success/failure.

failure_points.issue: Reports are written inside the runner and only kept as a 30-day artefact; nothing is committed, so there is no durable audit trail.
review-meta-labels.js audits meta:dependabot-security, which is not in labels.yml.
Scheduled at 04:00 UTC, inside the 02:00/03:00/04:00 cluster.
Scripts default to lightspeedwp/.github via LabelManager, so the audit is single-repository.

overlaps_with: labeling-unified.yml (scheduled-cleanup job is labelled an audit report but is a no-op)
